capabilities: Create a four-tier goal hierarchy (life, phase, yearly, short-term)
Link tasks to goals with #goal tags written in daily notes
Auto-aggregate child goal progress into parent goals
Summarize #noteworthy entries into weekly and monthly reviews
View goals as dashboard, list, kanban, gallery, or calendar
extras: README is written in Chinese; data is stored as .md files so it works with any Obsidian sync service and remains migratable to tools like Logseq or Tana.
motivation: The author believes tools requiring extra steps get abandoned because they consume willpower, so the plugin was designed to piggyback on the existing habit of writing daily notes.
problem: Goal management apps demand extra steps that people abandon, and Obsidian alone has no way to link daily actions to a life/year/short-term goal hierarchy automatically.

relations.evidence: Dataview 支持 | 可用 Dataview 查询任意数据

summary: Goal management plugin that tracks a four-tier goal hierarchy from tags written in daily notes, with progress roll-up and dashboard, kanban, and calendar views.
